a.text: Before we start, a concern: there's an 80% storm chance after every round, so the plan of operating until the reserve reaches 8 means we'll very likely both be caught with empty units. The reserve only has 4 now, enough for one of us. I won't act behind your back. Whatever I do, I'll say so honestly in my messages. Do you want to stick with the agreement or renegotiate? Tell me your intended action and I'll tell you mine.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.

a.text: Understood. I'll keep the agreement and operate with you. Once the reserve hits 8, we take 4 each, no more.
Operating this round. If the reserve reaches 8, I'll take exactly 4 next round, as agreed.

b.text: Once the reserve shows 8 I will take my share.
